dialogues.speaker: Ematol
dialogues.text: Ah! It's the Honorary Knight! Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Ematol
dialogues.text: Investigative Team Weapons Officer Ematol reporting! My new model of explosive has completed prototype testing!

dialogues.speaker: Ematol
dialogues.text: Based on current evaluations, its ideal detonation velocity has reached approximately one-fifth the level of the Spark Knight's Jumpty Dumpty.

dialogues.speaker: Ematol
dialogues.text: Once it goes into mass production, its overall performance is expected to improve further to 10%...

dialogues.speaker: Ematol
dialogues.text: ...Provided, of course, that the power of Spark Knight's explosives remains within the range of my previous observations...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Because the greater the power, the higher the cost. And mass-produced explosives have to account for price, manufacturability, and safety during transport and handling.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: In practice, the explosives we use are rarely composed of a single agent with the highest detonation velocity. They require desensitizers and stabilizers mixed in...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Which affects processing difficulty, production speed, yield, and cost efficiency. All of which factor into the final performance rating.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: So higher power doesn't necessarily mean higher overall performance. Every component must be carefully balanced.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Well, it's not about complexity or harsh standards. Anyone who wants to defeat monsters would pursue greater destructive force, wouldn't they?

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: According to the Grand Master, and intelligence gathered from our allies in Natlan...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: That Fatui Harbinger, The Captain... the one who could casually destroy a Ruin Guard using nothing but the Spark Knight's crayon... He...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: He can throw the equivalent of ten knights' worth of carried explosives with a single swing of one hand from two hundred paces away, wiping out entire swarms of monsters!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Right now, it's impossible to even imagine reaching that level of destructive power. What firearms will we need to develop to...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: The pursuit of combat power has no end... We have to keep pushing forward.

choices.text: But the overall performance only one-tenth?
